title: YIELDMAT: 1250 of 1250 on a sweep the source calls discovery plus held-out
upstream_status_verbatim: The former `G6-09` YIELDMAT row is signed off and removed (2026-07-11)
status_plain: YIELDMAT was identified, repaired and signed off at 1,250 of 1,250 bit-exact with a maximum of zero ULP, and the production kernel reproduces both former catalogue witnesses through its full basis logic. The identification found that Excel uses x87 spill-loop arithmetic with the published formula's own association, term1 = (1 + DIM/B*rate) - term2 with term2 reused, rather than the F-sharp-style left chain OxFunc had ported. The held-out status is PARTIAL, not clean: the source's exact words are discovery plus held-out, fresh seed, and it never says how many of the 1,250 probes were held out. Calling 1250/1250 a held-out figure overclaims; the row split cannot be filled.

counts.build_note: The document's section header at line 9 reads "## Identified calculation graph (live Excel 16.0 build 20131, x86-64)" and governs the graph section, not this validation bullet. The catalogue restates the build on its own version of the sentence; see the second count. Not inherited here.
counts.corpus_or_build: a 1,250-probe live sweep over discovery plus held-out with a fresh seed; the candidate space was a 128-candidate search over bases 2 and 3
counts.ambiguity_note: held_out is partial with a null row split: the sweep mixes the discovery probes the 128-candidate space was narrowed against with the held-out ones, and the source never separates them. corpus_was_repair_target is true for the same reason. cpu_scoped is true because the identified substrate is x87 spill-loop arithmetic.
